name: Windy
author: Marcelo Minholi
description: Condition, temperature, rain, and wind forecast in the bar, backed by Open-Meteo (default) or the Windy Point Forecast API

barWidget.description: Wind speed, gusts, and direction with an hourly outlook and a jump into windy.com. Free by default through Open-Meteo; Windy is available with an API key.

schema.label: Data provider
schema.description: Open-Meteo needs no API key and returns real data, free for non-commercial use. Windy uses your API key (a Professional plan is required for real forecasts). Auto uses Windy only when a key is stored.

schema.label: Forecast model
schema.description: Auto picks the highest-resolution model covering your coordinates and falls back to the global GFS.

schema.label: Temperature unit
schema.description: Auto follows the locale: Fahrenheit for US/Liberia/Myanmar, Celsius elsewhere. Rain switches to inches with Fahrenheit.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: What the bar pill shows. Temp is the condition icon plus temperature (default); wind is the rotating arrow plus speed; both shows the condition icon, temperature, wind arrow, and speed.

schema.label: Wind level
schema.description: Pressure level for the wind series. Surface is the 10 m wind; levels below are useful for paragliding and aviation.
